mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quote_security (symbol, sec_type, market, name, pinyin_abbr, status, currency, upstream_secid, missing_days, last_active_date) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{secType}, #{market}, #{name}, #{pinyinAbbr}, #{status}, #{currency}, #{upstreamSecid}, #{missingDays}, #{lastActiveDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market = VALUES(market), name = VALUES(name), pinyin_abbr = VALUES(pinyin_abbr), status = VALUES(status), currency = VALUES(currency), upstream_secid = IF(VALUES(upstream_secid) LIKE 'sina:%', upstream_secid, VALUES(upstream_secid)), missing_days = 0, last_active_date = VALUES(last_active_date)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE status <> 3 AND UPPER(symbol) LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(symbol), symbol LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE status <> 3 AND pinyin_abbr LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(pinyin_abbr), symbol LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE quote_security SET missing_days = missing_days + 1, status = IF(missing_days + 1 >= #{threshold}, 2, status), last_active_date = #{lastActiveDate} WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND sec_type = 1 AND (last_active_date IS NULL OR last_active_date < #{lastActiveDate})
